requirements.originalBreakdownItem: Base progression primarily on successfully completed rounds.
requirements.changes: A registered final catch persists its actual round/source/collection/score result immediately, separately from the existing delayed result presentation. Completion is idempotent per attempt. Pause cannot cancel a locked outcome; background/navigation/retry complete its presentation safely without incrementing totals twice. New attempts clear the prior pending state, and basket motion stops after logical round end. Existing scoring/progression rules are unchanged.
requirements.verification: Five new XCTest cases cover immediate persistence before host deallocation, repeated pause/background callbacks, unprotected bad-fruit commit, fresh retry and normal delayed presentation. Not executed on Mac.
requirements.remainingIssues: Run full gameplay/persistence/UI regressions and process-restart journeys on founder Mac; source fixtures do not establish physical-device kill durability.

requirements.originalBreakdownItem: Prevent muted or disabled audio from continuing to play.
requirements.changes: Suspend all audio on willResignActive as well as background entry; retain eligible loop requests and interruption permissions, never replay transient SFX or typing on activation.
requirements.verification: New actual-player runtime test source covers all channels and inactive requests/settings; NOT EXECUTED on Mac. Changed-file whitespace check passed.
requirements.remainingIssues: Execute on Mac; real device interruptions, route changes and listening quality remain unverified.
